text: Team lunch on Friday was nice, everyone chill and helpful so far.
Boss ok je, tapi dia jarang reply WhatsApp so kadang sy tunggu sampai petang nak confirm kerja.
Ok je setakat ni. Gaji tak lama lagi masuk, harap ok.

Ada colleague asyik kacau saya dalam group WhatsApp, siap hantar gambar saya tanpa izin. Saya dah lapor tapi takde tindakan.
Commute jauh gila tapi OK la, yang penting gaji betul-betul masuk.
Still don't know how the POS refund process works, nobody showed me and the manual is 80 pages.
Shift malam ni sampai 2 pagi, lepas tu start pagi lagi. Badan dah x larat.
My team lead keeps sending me sexual messages at night and says I'd get promoted if I'm nice to him.
note: explicit messages, implied quid pro quo

text: Hari-hari OT sampai malam, mati la kalau macam ni, tapi bos ok je.

note: no feedback until after the fact

text: Ok so far, team friendly, boss is chill, just still settling into the outlet routines.
Claim OT bulan lepas belum bayar lagi, dah masuk bulan ni, setiap kali tanya kena tunggu je.
Abang supervisor selalu 'tak sengaja' sentuh pinggang saya masa lalu depan stor. Saya rasa tak selesa.
Warehouse has a pallet jack with a dodgy brake and the supervisor said 'just be careful'.
Pelanggan komplain pasal stok habis sampai nak jerit, sabar je la kan.
note: hard negative: customer complaint is normal retail

text: Kerja dia banyak, tapi jobdesk tak sama dengan yang HR cerita masa interview.

Boss suruh buat stocktake malam ni, pagi esok pulak kena buka outlet, tak faham la deadline sebenar.
Supervisor cakap kalau saya report pasal shift saya, dia akan pastikan saya kena buang. Dia serius.
Feeling kinda lonely honestly, everyone already has their lunch group and I just eat at my desk.
Dah 3 minggu tak dapat training betul, main tengok je cara orang lain buat.
Gudang panas macam sauna pagi tadi, rasa nak rebah tapi gerak juga.

Honestly I think the team would manage better without me around, I've been thinking about it a lot at night.

Overtime from August still not in my pay, HR keeps saying 'next cycle' and that's been like three cycles.
Supervisor membebel pasal rak tak rapi, lepas tu dia sendiri pun ikut kemas. Okay la.
Kena ulang training online tiga kali sebab portal tak boleh login, takde siapa nak tolong.

Ok je, boss kata nanti kena buat presentation. Tak tahu tajuk apa.
Kepala aku dah serabut sebab 3 jenis kerja serentak, rasa nak cuti sehari je.

text: Sometimes I feel like the dumbest one in the room because nobody explains the stock codes.

note: continued after being asked to stop

text: Forklift kat dock belakang tak ada brek, pemandu baru tu tetap guna. Hampir langgar orang tadi.
Ada staff lelaki asyik panggil aku dengan nama ejekan depan semua orang dalam grup, dah report tapi takde tindakan.
OT sampai 12 malam hari-hari, rasa letih dah.
note: long OT, no wage issue stated

text: Can't figure out who I report to for the new outlet, my offer letter says one person and my WhatsApp says another.

x jelas arahan, sekejap kata buat ni, sekejap kata buat tu.

Pay came in on time and the commute is manageable, nothing big to complain about.
Sistem inventori tak dibuka untuk saya lagi, jadi kena tanya orang setiap kali nak order barang.

Mostly good, the store lead is supportive, though I still get lost in the planogram rules.

note: pay and cost of living only

text: Team lead selalu bagi kerja last minute, deadline tak pernah jelas, pening.

Stok rak hari ni habis, aku kena kemas 3 rak sorang, memang bengang je.

text: Dekat outlet baru ni banyak sangat benda kena ingat, SOP 40 muka surat, takde masa nak baca.

text: New starters get a buddy but I'm the only one who got no buddy and nobody's really shown me around.
Manager ni jarang ada kat outlet, bila dia tak ada, aku la kena jadi supervisor dan handle semua benda.

text: Aku masih tak tahu cara nak file cuti dalam sistem, jadi tanya rakan je.
